title: Evidence
description: Checker 的独立审计产物。无生产真值标签；基于叶契约 acceptance / .goal.md done criteria 的接地评估。评测终态判分器不进入本对象的生产路径。

criteria_defect.description: Set true ONLY when you have verified the workspace work is actually COMPLETE and CORRECT, but the stated done_criteria is itself wrong/impossible/imprecise (e.g. an arithmetic typo in an expected output, a criterion that cannot be satisfied). In that case keep audit_progress: 1.0 and explain the spec error in gaps/challenges — the Gate will then admit the leaf (the work is done; the gap is a defect in the spec, not the work). Leave false/absent otherwise.

integrity_violation.description: True when the Checker (or its tool chain) mutated task-relevant world state during audit. Gate must not admit (invariant #11 / gate_policy INTEGRITY).

audit_perspective.description: Optional audit lens for this tick (e.g. shortcut / alternatives / state_drift); rotated by context-compress; also mirrored in ticks.jsonl.
